notes.title: First Patch is live
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings!	[/h1]

Today we released our first patch! =)

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[b] Mod-Tool:[/b] 
The compiler now uses all available CPU cores of your machine, and indicates a progress bar. That way you know the process isn't stopping, and you see how long it takes to compile all textures, texts and shaders.

Compiling now will me much faster

[b]Engine:[/b]
Soundsystem - You heard the music, now you hear the sounds. Gunfire and explosions now can be heard, depending on how far or close the camera is to the unit.
Priority Targets - preparation for the AI. Units now prefer to attack other unit classes they are most efficient against, if now new attack order is given
Savegames - A bug was fixed for Windows Vista where occasionally you couldn't load your savegames anymore.
Armorsystem - Armor now has a much different effect on incoming damage depending what armor type it is - taking down the stations should take significant longer than destroying enemy units

[b]Game:[/b]
Fighter Launch - Fighters are now launched from carriers - this is a preparation for a carrier system we are currently developing.
New Units - some new units are added


[h1]Preview:[/h1]

[spoiler] Next Update will integrate the resource system for the Eidolon campaign.[/spoiler]
[spoiler] First hero Units will appear[/spoiler]
[spoiler] New Structures and the tech tree[/spoiler]
